resources.string: Checks the active app name and returns to Home when an app you selected to block opens. It does not read screen content.
Enable the service to block selected apps
Turn on the switch beside each app you want Vardely to block.
Activity is counted on this device only.
Vardely keeps these counts on your phone. They are not sent to a server.
Control how Vardely works on your phone.
Vardely checks the name of the app currently open so it can return to Home when that app is on your block list. It does not read screen text.
Vardely helps you choose apps that interrupt your focus. Blocking starts only after you enable the service and turn protection on.

To block only the apps you choose, Vardely needs Android Accessibility access to detect which app is currently open. It checks the app name against your block list and returns to Home when there is a match. Vardely does not read screen text, capture passwords, or send this information anywhere. You can turn this access off at any time in Android Settings. Continue to Accessibility settings?
